sections.label: Instruction to a son (opens "The proverbs of Solomon")
sections.opener: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

sections.label: The proverbs of Solomon, first collection
sections.opener: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son maketh a glad father: but a foolish son is the heaviness of his mother.

sections.label: The words of the wise
sections.opener: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.

sections.label: More sayings of the wise
sections.opener: These things also belong to the wise. It is not good to have respect of persons in judgment.

sections.label: More proverbs of Solomon, copied out by the men of Hezekiah
sections.opener: These are also proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

sections.label: The words of Agur
sections.opener: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, even the prophecy: the man spake unto Ithiel, even unto Ithiel and Ucal,

sections.label: The words of king Lemuel
sections.opener: The words of king Lemuel, the prophecy that his mother taught him.

kings432.text: And he spake three thousand proverbs: and his songs were a thousand and five.

eccl129.text: And moreover, because the preacher was wise, he still taught the people knowledge; yea, he gave good heed, and sought out, and set in order many proverbs.
